clue.text: Welsh river name

parts.note: the Cam is the river that flows through Cambridge
Brian is a man's first name

explanation.surface: A query about what a river in Wales is called.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Welsh river' reads as one phrase, but 'Welsh' is the definition and 'river' starts the wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: Cambria is the old Latin name for Wales, so its adjective is a poetic synonym for Welsh.

clue.text: Firm at this point must be consistent

parts.note: Co. is the abbreviation for company, a firm
at this point means here

explanation.surface: A company here must keep its story straight.
explanation.definitionFit: To hang together logically is to be consistent; the verb is a direct synonym.

clue.text: People take one as a threat

parts.note: men means people
an ace counts as one in cards and dice

explanation.surface: People regard a certain someone as dangerous.
explanation.definitionFit: A menace is a danger or threat, a straightforward synonym.

clue.text: Is in a hurry to get results of the day's shooting

definitions.meaning: in film-making, the unedited prints of a day's filming viewed afterwards

explanation.definitionFit: The first sense is the verb for hurrying; the second is film jargon for daily unedited prints, also called dailies.

clue.text: Run as "today's politician"?

parts.note: AD (anno Domini) dates our present era, so it stands for today's
a minister is a government politician

explanation.surface: A question of whether governing counts as being a modern politician.
explanation.definitionFit: To administer a department or estate is to run or manage it.

clue.text: Effect of childish behaviour?

definitions.meaning: the influence or impression something makes
read playfully as the act of an imp, a mischievous child

explanation.definitionFit: Impact means effect or influence; the second reading splits the word into an imp's act.

clue.text: Of importance, but not spiritual

definitions.meaning: physical, worldly, concerned with bodily things

explanation.definitionFit: Material can mean relevant and significant, or physical and worldly as opposed to spiritual.

clue.text: Order something to eat

definitions.meaning: in the idiom for perfect neatness, everything in its place

explanation.definitionFit: Apple-pie order is an idiom for perfect tidiness, and the dish itself is a familiar baked dessert.

clue.text: Giving pleasure, while standing around

definitions.meaning: read as standing a round, paying for everyone's drinks

explanation.walkthrough: 'standing around' looks like idling, but it means standing a round in the pub, buying everyone a drink.
explanation.definitionFit: Treating someone gives them pleasure, and buying a round of drinks is also called treating.

clue.text: Good-looking worker getting part

parts.note: a hand is a manual worker, as in farmhand
some means a part of something

explanation.surface: An attractive labourer lands a role.
explanation.definitionFit: Handsome is a common synonym for attractive in looks.

clue.text: Main type of fastener

definitions.meaning: a bent wire clip for holding papers together

explanation.definitionFit: A staple food is the principal one, and a staple is also the wire clip that binds sheets.

clue.text: Coward going about in trance, perhaps

parts.note: re means about or concerning

indicators.note: perhaps signals that the letters of trance are one possible arrangement, to be reshuffled

explanation.surface: A frightened man wanders about in a daze.
explanation.walkthrough: 'perhaps' gives CREANT; 'Coward' may suggest Noel Coward the playwright, but it is a plain noun.
explanation.definitionFit: A recreant is an archaic word for a cowardly or faithless person.

clue.text: Dedicated skill, involving study, …

indicators.note: involving means the word for skill takes in the word for study

parts.note: art means skill
a den is a private study room

explanation.walkthrough: The ellipses chain this clue to 14 and 18 across in one long sentence; each part is solved alone.
explanation.definitionFit: An ardent supporter is a passionately dedicated one.

clue.text: Underworld entertainment that can be off-putting

parts.note: Dis is the Roman god of the underworld, and his realm
a concert is a musical entertainment

explanation.surface: A hellish show that could put an audience off.
explanation.definitionFit: To disconcert someone is to unsettle or put them off, so it means to be off-putting.

clue.text: … to turn Paris into a dream, …

indicators.note: to turn means the letters of these words are turned around into a new order

explanation.surface: Part of a sentence about transforming the French capital into a fantasy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to turn' scrambles PARIS, INTO and A together; 'into' looks like a link but is fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: An aspiration is a hope or ambition, what one dreams of achieving.

clue.text: Onion ring found in Jerusalem

indicators.note: found in means the word for ring sits inside the name for Jerusalem

parts.note: Sion, also spelt Zion, is a name for Jerusalem
to ring someone is to call them

explanation.surface: An onion ring turned up in the Holy City.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Onion ring' reads as one fried snack; split it, with 'Onion' the definition and 'ring' the wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: A scallion is a spring onion or green onion.

clue.text: One going abroad on allowance from music group

parts.note: EMI is a well-known record company
a grant is an allowance of money

explanation.surface: A traveller living abroad on a stipend from a record label.
explanation.definitionFit: An emigrant leaves their own country to settle in another.

clue.text: She may be a little time

parts.note: be, the verb, here from may be
a trice is a very short moment, as in in a trice

explanation.surface: Perhaps a woman takes only a moment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'She' is a vague definition for any woman's name.
explanation.definitionFit: Beatrice is a female name, so a woman referred to as she.

clue.text: … skill and experience

parts.note: the end of the chained sentence, describing the know-how that makes someone capable

explanation.definitionFit: Competence is the ability to do something well, built on skill and practice.

clue.text: Ring everybody up about fabulous bird

annotationWithheld.why: Ring everybody up about fabulous bird: the only parse puts ALL inside ROC and turns the whole with 'up', which stands between the two pieces; the check refuses that reversal and no single-piece reversal gives COLLAR
annotationWithheld.clue: Ring everybody up about fabulous bird

clue.text: Union measure

definitions.meaning: an old unit of distance, about three miles

explanation.definitionFit: A league is an alliance of parties and also an old measure of distance.

clue.text: Music suggesting bad weather's on the way

indicators.note: in a down clue, on means one piece sits on top of the other

parts.note: St is the abbreviation for street, a way
rain is bad weather

explanation.surface: A tune that hints a storm is coming.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down entry, RAIN being 'on' ST puts ST first.
explanation.definitionFit: A strain is a passage or snatch of music or melody.

clue.text: Gun-toting general's deputy

indicators.note: toting means carrying, so the general carries the gun inside

parts.note: Robert E. Lee was the Confederate general
gat is slang for a gun

explanation.surface: An armed officer acting as his commander's second.
explanation.definitionFit: A legate is an envoy or deputy, especially a papal one.

clue.text: Audacious when ten lions assembled

indicators.note: assembled means the letters of these words are put together in a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A bold act when a pride of big cats gathers.
explanation.definitionFit: Insolent means rudely bold or impudent, close in sense to audacious.

clue.text: Italy endlessly leaning to the right

definitions.meaning: used adjectivally, of ancient Italy and its peoples
describing a slanted typeface that slopes right throughout

explanation.walkthrough: The first sense is the adjective for ancient Italy (the Italic languages); the second is sloping type.
explanation.definitionFit: Italic describes ancient Italy and its peoples, and also a typeface sloping to the right.

clue.text: Gall in pear causes disease on the skin

indicators.note: causes means the letters of gall and pear combine to produce something new

explanation.surface: Bitterness inside a fruit brings on a skin complaint.
explanation.definitionFit: Pellagra is a vitamin-deficiency disease marked by dermatitis on the skin.

clue.text: Lower contents of one thermos flask

indicators.note: contents of means the letters sit inside the words that follow

explanation.surface: What is inside a vacuum flask.
explanation.definitionFit: Nether means lower, as in the nether regions.

clue.text: Medical man takes time to fish

indicators.note: takes means the word for the doctor holds the letter inside

parts.note: a surgeon is a medical man

explanation.surface: A doctor spends some time angling.
explanation.definitionFit: The sturgeon is a large fish, source of caviar.
